instruction: Take the receipt image OIP.jpg from /home/user and convert it into a PDF file called 'invoice.pdf', then save it in the Documents folder.

metadata.explanation: Task requires converting the receipt image to a PDF with a different filename (invoice.pdf) and saving it to Documents folder instead of Desktop. The evaluator checks: 1) PDF exists at /home/user/Documents/invoice.pdf, 2) PDF has exactly 1 page, and 3) PDF contains image content. Uses custom getter pdf_file_a503b07f to download the PDF file and custom metric check_pdf_content_a503b07f to verify page count and image content.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all instruction requirements: PDF location (/home/user/Documents/invoice.pdf), page count (1 page), and image content
Getter logic is correct: downloads PDF from the specified path using env.controller.get_file()
Metric logic is semantically sound: checks page count via PdfReader, inspects PDF XObjects for images when verify_content=true (lines 58-85), and validates file size (>10KB minimum)
Complete coverage: The evaluator can distinguish between a properly converted image PDF vs an empty or text-only PDF
Edge case handling: Metric properly handles None returns from getter, file existence checks, and exceptions during PDF reading
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Update getter return type annotation from Optional[str] to str in signature, or update metric first parameter to Optional[str] for consistency (though metric already handles None correctly at runtime)

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_pdf_content_a503b07f first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_pdf_file_a503b07f return type (Optional)
